inlines.v: OM'PHACINE, adjective [Gr. from unripe fruit.] Pertaining to or expressed from unripe fruit. omphacine oil is a viscous brown juice extracted from green olives. With this the wrestlers in the ancient gymnastic exercises used to anoint their bodies.
